metadata.description: Agent skills for SubImage, the cloud-native security platform: onboarding cloud/SaaS data sources and operator workflows over the SubImage MCP server.

plugins.name: subimage-setup
plugins.description: Onboard cloud and SaaS data sources into SubImage from your IaC or CLI environment (AWS, GCP, Azure, GitHub, Kubernetes outpost).

plugins.name: subimage-mcp
plugins.description: Operator workflows over the SubImage MCP server: triage findings, investigate CVEs, review attack paths, audit coverage, author Cypher queries and custom rules, and identify Infrastructure-as-Code repositories.
